body.h: For most three person passing patterns the jugglers stand in a triangle as shown above. A club thrown from Anne to Ben, or Ben to Clare, or Clare to Anne will travel anticlockwise around the triangle. I have incorporated this picture into the causal diagrams for the three person patterns.
